company.name: Blueshoe
company.shortDescription: Blueshoe is the first AI-native consumer and plaintiff law firm.
company.description:
Blueshoe makes getting legal counsel as easy as ordering an Uber. A real law firm, powered by tech, on-demand for everyone.
Consumers and small businesses represent half of the $400 billion U.S. legal market. Yet every year, more than $100 billion in legal needs go unmet because finding trustworthy, affordable help remains too difficult. For too long, technology has enriched traditional big law firms and corporate departments without fundamentally improving how legal services are delivered to real people.
Blueshoe reimagines the way people find and engage legal services. It meets them where they already are: the web, messaging apps, and across the AI tools they use every day. Intelligent intake, agentic workflows, and transparent pricing make it easy for people to understand their options and get the help they need.
For lawyers, Blueshoe provides the operating system to build and grow a modern practice. It brings qualified clients, handles operational complexity, and provides the technology platform that powers service delivery. Attorneys gain work flexibility, lower overhead, and more time dedicated to client work.
